guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Standard Freddie Mac conforming delivery path where AUS, collateral, and documentation meet current Seller/Servicer Guide requirements.
keyRequirements: LPA/AUS findings and documentation level must be eligible.
Occupancy and purpose limits must satisfy current guide.
Income, assets, and liabilities must be fully reconciled.
documentationExpectations: Income validation package tied to underwriting method.
Asset and reserve verification with sourcing support.
Collateral and project eligibility package as required.
edgeCases: Project or insurance exceptions impacting condo delivery.
commonDenialReasons: Ineligible AUS risk class or findings mismatch.
Documentation quality gaps in variable income.
overlayCaveats: Investors often tighten DTI and reserve minimums above guide baseline.
Credit overlays frequently step up for non-primary occupancy.
compensatingFactors: Strong reserve profile and low payment shock.
workflowNotes: Capture overlay matrix at lock to avoid rework.
Re-validate AUS after any borrower liability changes.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Affordable conventional option for income-limited households, requiring AMI validation and program-specific execution controls.
keyRequirements: Borrower AMI must be within current Home Possible thresholds.
Primary residence occupancy is required in most cases.
AUS findings and MI structure must remain eligible.
documentationExpectations: Program-required borrower education evidence where applicable.
edgeCases: AMI threshold edge cases with variable/bonus income.
Overlay reserve adjustments with higher DTI.
commonDenialReasons: AMI exceeds allowable ratio for census tract.
overlayCaveats: Investors may require stronger credit for higher-LTV affordable loans.
Overlay reserve floors can override baseline AUS tolerance.
compensatingFactors: Strong residual reserves and stable payment history.
Conservative DTI after verified income treatment.
workflowNotes: Run AMI eligibility before final product recommendation.
Document overlay deltas in underwriting submission.

rules.amiNote: Home Possible has income limits; confirm current requirements for the subject property.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Freddie renovation execution requiring documented scope, compliant contractor package, and as-completed collateral approach.
keyRequirements: Renovation scope and bids must meet program standards.
As-completed valuation and contingency controls are mandatory.
Loan file must support draw and completion monitoring.
edgeCases: Property condition delays for appraisal completion.
commonDenialReasons: Incomplete renovation package or ineligible scope.
Timeline mismatch for lock and closing.
overlayCaveats: Investor overlays commonly add reserve and contractor requirements.
Renovation concentration controls may apply by seller.
compensatingFactors: Low leverage profile with verified reserves.
Experienced contractor and complete project controls.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Refinance-relief style execution for eligible borrowers where benefit, history, and current guide constraints are met.
keyRequirements: Performance history and eligibility path must match current guide.
Refinance benefit tests and cost controls must be documented.
Subordinate lien treatment must align with execution path.
documentationExpectations: Payment history support and mortgage profile evidence.
commonDenialReasons: Overlay limits tighter than baseline rules.
overlayCaveats: Investors may apply stricter DTI/reserve constraints for relief refi.
Additional payment-history seasoning overlays are common.
compensatingFactors: Clear borrower savings and improved risk profile.
workflowNotes: Validate payoff and subordinate data at intake.
Preserve complete NTB evidence for post-close review.
